paragraphs: The XF 3.0 V6 uses the AJ30 - a 3.0-litre naturally aspirated V6 petrol engine. It was fitted from 2007 to 2015 across the X250 generation of the XF, making it one of the earlier petrol options in the XF range before the supercharged AJ126 arrived later in the generation. The AJ30 is shared with other Jaguar models of the era, including the S-Type and early XJ, and represents a distinct engine family from the later AJ126 supercharged unit.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ30 engines for every XF 3.0 V6 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre naturally aspirated V6 petrol engine fitted to the XF 3.0 V6 from 2007 to 2015 (X250 generation). No widely-reported specific engine issue confirmed for this variant application.
